name: SNL Bearings Limited
about: SNL Bearings Limited manufactures and markets antifriction bearing products in India and internationally. The company offers small and big end cages; full complement shells; cage-guided shells; and needle rollers. The company also offers needle roller bearings and bearing components. In addition, it offers finished goods such as bearings, special purpose machines and spare parts, and engages in the sale of machinery, scrap, and exports. It serves automobile, general engineering, railways, electrical equipment manufacturing, and related industries. The company was formerly known as Shriram Needle Bearing Industries Limited. SNL Bearings Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India. SNL Bearings Limited operates as a subsidiary of NRB Bearings Limited.
